_comment: The schema's own fixture: a taxonomy that belongs to no project and exists only to exercise every form the schema claims to express. It is deliberately NOT a copy of a live project's layout - a fixture that tracks a real taxonomy drifts from it silently, which is the defect that took TheGame's copy out of this folder.
_lint_comment: A flat library is the one-pattern case: the family is the single segment below Assets, and the fixture declares no assemblies so the compositional rule stays opt-in rather than something every project inherits.

redirects.why: a persona is narrative, not a resource the character folder owns

rules._form: 1 - a subfolder that depends on the prefix INSIDE a context, and collapses when the rig itself is being placed
2 - a closed list of a fact's values, and 4 - a value whose whole meaning is the absence of the level
3 - the shape of a fact as a pattern, plus a sub resolved by PREFIX rather than by kind
4 - a refusal at the level of one VALUE, and a fact that spans several segments
5 - the destination of the cross-context redirect
an optional fact: the level exists only when the caller names it
a name the context refuses outright, whatever the facts

name_refuses.why: maps carry no prefix - the .umap file type is the discrimination
